subtasks: Cover the blocks from left to right, remember their colors, then uncover them in the order: red, green, and blue.
Uncover the red block on the right. Lift its yellow cover and place the cover back in front of the red block.
Uncover the green block on the left. Lift the leftmost yellow cover and place it back in front of the green block.
Uncover the blue block in the middle. Lift the middle yellow cover and place it back in front of the blue block, then return both arms to their starting poses.
